metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: AI — Prompt Injection via Image/Document Upload
properties.description: Detects indirect prompt injection through uploaded images, PDFs, or documents containing hidden instructions
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "prompt" or Message contains "injection" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 2 // AZ-AI-PD-030
